title: Natural Earth 1:110m land and coastline locator
accepted_by: Relic implementation review under the selected reference-data plan
publication_boundary: Bundled local map display assets only; not inserted into analytical evidence or an accepted administrative-boundary baseline.

vintage.meaning: Repository release date, not an observation or last-survey date.

scope.selection: Only these two complete small GeoJSON files, plus the pinned publisher licence and VERSION.

rights.permitted_use: Local display, distribution and derived display geometry under the publisher public-domain dedication.

identity.raw: No stable per-feature publisher identifier is supplied in these GeoJSON files.
identity.mapping: Each display feature maps to the same raw feature-array index in the exact retained file. IDs do not assert cross-release physical identity.

remaining_limits: Generalized 1:110m locator geometry; not navigation or surveyed detail.
Coordinate/ring checks do not prove topology, world accuracy or completeness.
No legal/administrative membership, geocoding, incident association or evidence support may use this display asset.
Release date is known; per-feature real-world observation dates are not supplied.

refresh.policy: Review and validate a separately pinned release before replacement; retain these raw assets/manifest for reproduction. Failed refresh keeps this accepted display release.

catalogue_policy: The research catalogue remains a disabled candidate registry. This acceptance applies only to the named locator assets and does not enable other products.
